name: Can I still file a claim if my quadriplegia injury was partly my fault?

mainEntity.name: Can I still file a claim if my quadriplegia injury was partly my fault?

acceptedAnswer.text: In California, you can still pursue a claim even if you were partly at fault for the accident that caused your quadriplegia injury. California operates under a pure comparative negligence system. This means that your compensation may be reduced by the percentage of fault assigned to you. For example, if you are found 20% at fault, your total damages would be reduced by 20%. An attorney can help determine fault and maximize your potential recovery.
acceptedAnswer.description: In California, you can still file a claim even if partly at fault, but your compensation may be reduced by your percentage of fault.
